known_boundaries: Factory current-time synthetic authority is known; not a newly discovered vulnerability.
Owner resume permission exists; task permission and domain confirmation must be evaluated separately.
C01 has no payment; PRE_PAYMENT is NOT_APPLICABLE.
R01 recovery is read-only reconciliation, not a new payment authorization.
D01 is delivery bookkeeping recovery, not HTTP retransmission.
Missing original timestamps imply UNKNOWN expiry; session creation time does not establish original confirmation time.
An uninspected private source is INPUT_LIMIT, not evidence that no record exists anywhere.
